release.content: pubkit 0.13.0 was released on 2026-10-25 from commit ab19081ce4506f404a794d763701e4f3b29a27f0 with these changes.

rows: terraform/dns-zone keys each Cloudflare record by its rrset and its value ("nameservers ns1.desec.io", "email_mx 10 mxext1.mailbox.org") instead of its position, except A, AAAA and CNAME records, whose values may be known only after apply. A provider joining a zone shifted position keys, and Cloudflare refused a record created while another, being changed, still held its value. A root module moving from 0.12.6 or earlier adds the moved blocks pubkit dns moves writes from terraform show -json, so its plan shows only moves

./pubkit, a managed script in every repository, runs the pubkit the repository pins through uvx and that release's wheel, in the repository's root from any directory, whichever pubkit is installed; without uv it says how to install it

pubkit dns moves reads terraform show -json on stdin and writes the moved blocks taking terraform/dns-zone's Cloudflare records from position keys to keys by value. README: the deSEC provider's retry_max (30) keeps a zone's first apply within deSEC's 15 rrset writes a minute
